name: Inaho Shin
source:
Memories Off 6 ~T-Wave~:
Hobbies: Internet, traveling.
Likes: Talking, Japanese Culture.
Dislikes: Preaching, studying.

A regular at the restaurant "Fumi" and a freeter. He makes a living working part-time at the chain restaurant "Ressac."  He is alumnus from Sumisora High School where his activities at the school festival have turned into legend. Although he gives out the impression of a frivolous and shallow person, in truth, Shin is loyal to a fault and dependable. He has an older sister who is actually [spoiler] [url=/c13504]Suzushiro Rein[/url], whose real name is Inaho Suzu[/spoiler]

Memories Off 6: Next Relation:
In his vacation from working at the chain restaurant "Ressac," Shin had to go out for a summer only long-term part-time job in an onsen (spa) located in a ryokan (traditional inn).

[Translated from the [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off%E3%82%B7%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BA%E3%81%AE%E7%99%BB%E5%A0%B4%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9#Memories_Off.E5.88.9D.E5.87.BA]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
